name: prediction-market-amm
notes: H004 gates resolution to [expiry, expiry+claimWindow]. The market here expires in 2100, so at a single point in time only the trading phase and the resolve-before-expiry refusal are reachable; the post-expiry resolve/redeem/sweep lifecycle needs time control this harness does not have (create refuses a past expiry, and there is no wait step). That lifecycle is proven deployable by the offline verifyForDeploy gate (`bounded verify` step below, approved) and pinned by the structural contract test scripts/tests/skill-new-prediction-market.test.mjs. H005 (two sells in one atomic setMany paying twice) is likewise not reproducible here: this runner submits each set separately, and separate submissions are already safe; the getAfter fix is exercised by the offline proof and the contract test.

data.question: Will it rain in Lisbon on 2099-12-31?

tests.note: creator omitted (hook stages @user.address); pot seeded 0.01 SOL at 1:1
hook-derived creator must be null at create
open position; owner staged by hook
positions must start at zero balance

H004: the market expires in 2100, so resolution before expiry is refused (@time.now >= expiryTs). This is the attack - resolving NO against the only trader before the term ends, then sweeping the zero-winner branch - and it is now denied. The post-expiry resolve/redeem/sweep lifecycle is covered by the offline proof and the contract test (see notes).
